{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured knit blouse in #3b2417 brown, tailored fit with a relaxed collar to layer effortlessly over the base, mid-length hem falling at the hip.  
Tailored wool-blend trousers in #5a3a2a brown, straight-leg cut with a moderate rise for ease of movement, full length resting just above the heel.  
Loafers in #4e3022 dark brown leather, slip-on style with minimal detailing and a comfortable flat sole for all-day wear.  

This outfit works because it honors your request for a non-flashy look while maintaining a polished everyday aesthetic suitable for an office setting. The warm brown tonal palette creates a cohesive, professional appearance that feels grounded rather than loud. Every piece prioritizes comfort and functionality without sacrificing the neat structure expected in a work environment during autumn."}
